body:
Which platform?"  In-game

Staff Member: faht

Guilty? (Yes or No):Yes

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: It has been a year since i was banned and a few months ago i had appealed and they said wait a few months a do it again. Then here i am now, i was banned for  Hacking-Triggerbot-[R] on December 3rd, 2015, exactly 1 year and 16 days since that happened. I would like to be unbanned because when i was playing on here, i was on always when i could.
sometime before i was thinking about upgrading to Emerald (current rank: gold) and i was still thinking about that if i was unassumingly unbanned.

Any additional comments?:
I hope you take this appeal the right way and grant me the right to join back to the beautiful/wonderful server.

Sincerely, Aiden Hester (kolby85)


When i tried to appeal earlier it gave me an error message
